why: OpenAI announced on 2026-09-08 (covered by Quanta Magazine and others) a claimed counterexample: a forced, initially smooth finite-energy 3D Navier-Stokes flow developing a finite-time singularity, with an accompanying Lean formalization produced using ~10,000 AI agents; OpenAI explicitly did not claim the Clay Prize, and the result concerns forced flow, leaving the unforced Millennium Prize problem open, but the claim directly addresses the stated existence/smoothness question and names AI as central to producing it.
